items.title: CVS announces plan to split into 2 companies, stock sinks 10%
items.summary: CVS announced plans to separate into two independent, publicly traded companies on Wednesday, reshaping one of the largest healthcare companies in the US.

items.title: CVS scraps retail spin-off plans, reversing course on Aetna deal
items.summary: CVS (CVS) about-faces on its $70 billion Aetna merger strategy, scrapping plans to spin off its retail business. The decision marks a major shift for the healthcare giant as it rethinks its business model and the future of its pharmacy and insurance operations.

items.title: AI data center stocks and Musk's companies take hits as Democrats take control
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Pras Subramanian, Jake Conley, and Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, break down the latest market headlines, including the Democrats retaking Congress and its possible negative effects on AI stocks and Elon Musk's companies. Plus, the team dives into the stocks to watch: CVS (CVS), McDonald's (MCD), Meta (META), and Uber (UBER).

items.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 4: Dow Surges 3% in Biggest Post-Midterm Rally in 44 Years
